key_insight: svMultiPhysics is an open-source finite element platform that unifies fluid, solid, diffusion, and electrophysiology solvers to study coupled cardiovascular behavior in one framework.
engineering_relevance: The solver supports patient-specific cardiovascular simulations and can accelerate selected linear solves with GPU hardware, making it useful for research and translational modeling workflows.
method: Parallel C++ finite element solver for multiphysics PDEs
Modular coupling of solid mechanics, fluid dynamics, diffusion, and cardiac electrophysiology
Designed for independent or fully coupled simulations within SimVascular
evidence_signal: The abstract reports preliminary GPU-enabled runs achieving up to about 30× wall-clock speedup for selected linear solver configurations versus CPU-based simulations.
watch_item: The reported performance gain is preliminary and applies only to selected linear solver setups, so broader robustness and end-to-end speedup may vary.
paper_title: svMultiPhysics: a finite element-based solver for cardiovascular simulations
